description: This file contains Python source code defining benchmarking classes for Hugging Face language models, including methods to load models and prepare inputs for speech and text generation tasks.

classes.name: Benchmark
classes.description: Base class for model benchmarking with an unimplemented method for obtaining models and inputs.

classes.name: WhisperBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for Whisper speech-to-text models, providing methods to load models and generate input data.

classes.name: TextGenerationBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for text generation models, providing methods to load models and generate input data.

methods.name: pip_install
methods.description: Function to install Python packages using pip.

methods.name: get_model_and_inputs
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve model and inputs, to be implemented by subclasses.
